reviews.title: Premium Bug
reviews.text: I’ll remove this once fixed because the app is excellent. But I’m being offered a discount on premium, but then when I try to accept this, the regular price is applied when paying. Please might you fix this?

reviews.title: Scam offer
reviews.text: The app offered an in-app special for the premium version for 90% off but charged me the full price. Predatory behavior.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: Notifications do not work. You do need to remind yourself to start fasting and finish fasting. Feedback is also not working.

reviews.title: Used to be free
reviews.text: This all used to be free.  Now you need a subscription just to log times.  Totally not worth $60 a year.

reviews.title: Fake discount
reviews.text: Says claim your offer and then you are charged full price. Don’t be fooled. Don’t accept.

reviews.title: Start days need to coincide
reviews.text: How can you fast more 20 hours and start days not be the same. Need to allow start days to match for more than one logged fast.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: iPhone widget doesn’t work. Just a blur of letters and numbers. No widget at all for the phone. If you open the app the timer works but that’s about all it’s good for. Much better apps out there.

reviews.title: Too basic for the price. Very disappointed
reviews.text: Very disappointed, pretty useless and not even free

reviews.title: Missing Data
reviews.text: I had enjoyed the FastHabit app, but I got a new phone today, and all of my data is now missing. And this is despite the fact that I pay for the premium version and had all of my data saved to my phones cloud. There is also no way to contact any sort of customer support, if you go to the “Provide Feedback” option, it takes you to a 404 page not found.

reviews.title: Lost all info
reviews.text: Push notifications work half the time, bought new phone and all recorded fasts were gone forever, not retrievable

reviews.title: Not easy
reviews.text: I tried this app for two days.  Easy, log my food, I could scan my food, it counted calories.  I kept track of my water.  I then subscribed and couldn’t find what it did before my purchase.  I deleted my subscription after trying to figure it out, what a waste of time.  I feel like they set you up so you buy the $6.99 a month one.

reviews.title: Paid one off fee in 2018
reviews.text: I downloaded and paid £1.99 for full use of this app in 2018. I didn’t realise they would totally discard that, when subscriptions became the norm, and ask me for a yearly fee. Forget that!!

reviews.title: Just cheated me
reviews.text: I got a notification on my app that I could get a year for $5.99.  When I clicked on it to ok the purchase it changed to $59.99.  That’s not what I want.  Hope I can figure out how t contact them  and get my money back
